qualifier: p53 and DREAM repression of cell-cycle genes
name: G2/M progression and p53-DREAM transcriptional repression
rationale: Members concern G2/M progression and its transcriptional repression by p53 and DREAM/p107/p130 complexes plus GTSE1 and MASTL, whereas the close confusables centre on cyclin B-CDK1, PLK and checkpoint kinase events.

name: Epigenetic chromatin regulation by methylation and remodelling complexes
rationale: Members span histone and DNA methylation, histone-modifying enzymes, BAF/CHD/NuRD remodelling complexes, imprinting and X inactivation, while confusables are restricted to protein acetylation and nucleosome assembly.

name: Disuse-induced skeletal muscle atrophy
rationale: Members describe skeletal muscle atrophy in response to inactivity with SCF-mediated proteolysis, unlike confusables about hypertrophy, cardiac adaptation and myoblast development.

qualifier: activity control by SOS and GAPs
name: RAS GTPase activity control by SOS and GAPs
rationale: Members cover RAS activation by SOS/SHC and inactivation by GAPs including NF1 and GAP/RAS mutants, whereas confusables concern downstream RAF/MAPK and ERK regulation.

name: Peroxide and ischemic stress responses with ferroptosis
rationale: Members concern responses to hydrogen peroxide, hydroperoxides, ischemia and oxygen/sulfide with iron-dependent ferroptosis, distinguishing them from confusables about nitrosative stress, apoptosis regulation and respiration.

qualifier: Pol I transcription and spacer endonucleolytic cleavage
name: Pre-rRNA transcription and endonucleolytic spacer cleavage
rationale: Members are endonucleolytic cleavages in 5'-ETS, ITS1 and ITS2 of the tricistronic pre-rRNA plus Pol I rRNA transcription activation, unlike confusables on Pol I/III elongation and termination or general ribosome biogenesis.

qualifier: oncogenic BRAF, RAF1 and MEK mutants
name: RAF activation and oncogenic BRAF, RAF1, MEK mutants
rationale: Members cover RAF activation (including MRAS-SHOC2) and signalling by BRAF, RAF1, MAP2K and RAS mutants, while confusables add ERK negative feedback, fusions or integrin/Rap1 linkage.

name: Plasma membrane SLC transporter co-expression signatures
rationale: All members are co-expression modules enriched for plasma membrane SLC and ion transporters, whereas confusables are specific transport reactions for amino acids, urate or organic ions.

qualifier: transport and detoxification of transition and heavy metals
name: Transition and heavy metal ion transport and detoxification
rationale: Members cover iron, zinc, copper, manganese, cadmium and heme uptake, efflux, homeostasis and detoxification, unlike confusables centred on heme biosynthesis, oxygen sensing or ascorbate.

name: Telomere maintenance by telomerase, capping and recombination control
rationale: Members concern telomerase assembly and Cajal body trafficking, telomere capping, and suppression of telomeric recombination, while confusables focus on C-strand synthesis and replication-associated telomere maintenance.

name: Metallothionein-mediated cadmium and heavy metal detoxification
rationale: Members cover MTF1-induced metallothioneins and responses to cadmium, zinc, copper, mercury and iron, distinguished from confusables on zinc transport and manganese, cobalt or lead responses.

name: Sister chromatid cohesion, condensation and centromeric CENP-A deposition
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading and resolution, mitotic and meiotic chromosome condensation and CENP-A deposition, unlike confusables on meiotic recombination, spindle assembly or nucleosome assembly.

name: VEGF-neuropilin and Tie2 endothelial receptor signalling
rationale: Members are VEGF-VEGFR/neuropilin binding and Tie2 signalling supporting endothelial survival and lymphangiogenesis, whereas confusables concern regulation of sprouting angiogenesis and VEGFR2 signalling.

name: Carnitine-dependent fatty acid oxidation and acyl-CoA metabolism
rationale: Members cover the carnitine shuttle and transport, long- and medium-chain fatty acid catabolism and malonyl/succinyl-CoA metabolism, distinct from confusables on ketone bodies and individual beta-oxidation steps.

name: Protein S-palmitoylation and lipidated Wnt and Hedgehog secretion
rationale: Members concern cysteine palmitoylation/depalmitoylation and lipidation-dependent Wnt and Hedgehog ligand biogenesis and release, unlike confusables on Hh autoprocessing, geranylgeranylation or non-canonical Wnt.

name: SUMO maturation, deconjugation and substrate SUMOylation
rationale: Members cover SUMO proteolytic processing, desumoylation and SUMOylation of repair, nuclear envelope, RNA-binding and ubiquitin-pathway proteins, while confusables emphasise E1/E2 conjugation and chromatin or transcription factor targets.

name: Monoamine neurotransmitter synthesis, transport and degradation
rationale: Members cover catecholamine and serotonin biosynthesis, transporter uptake, vesicular loading and MAO/COMT degradation with sympathoadrenal development, unlike confusables on dopamine receptor signalling, BH4 or other neurotransmitters.

name: Brown and beige adipocyte differentiation control
rationale: Members regulate brown and beige fat cell differentiation and restrain adipose development and thermogenesis, distinct from confusables on white adipogenesis or cold-induced thermogenesis activation.

name: Regulation of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation
rationale: Members regulate differentiation of monocytes, macrophages, granulocytes and dendritic cells including GM-CSF response, whereas confusables concern neutrophil/G-CSF, myeloid progenitors or M-CSF signalling.

qualifier: cation-chloride cotransport, Na+/H+ exchange and osmoregulation
name: Cation-chloride cotransport, Na+/H+ exchange and osmotic volume regulation
rationale: Members cover SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters, SLC9 Na+/H+ exchangers and their diseases with osmotic responses, unlike confusables on bicarbonate/anion exchange or potassium channel regulation.

name: Leloir pathway galactose catabolism and galactosemias
rationale: All members concern the Leloir galactose pathway and its GALT/GALM deficiencies, distinct from confusables on fructose, pentose or alditol metabolism.

qualifier: amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Organic acid and amide metabolism via amino acid conjugation
rationale: Members combine broad organic acid and amide metabolism with glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, whereas confusables are specific amino acid catabolic pathways.

qualifier: Dishevelled activation and destruction complex disassembly
name: Wnt-induced Dishevelled activation and destruction complex disassembly
rationale: Members describe ligand-driven DVL activation and AXIN recruitment that dismantles the destruction complex, unlike confusables on destruction complex mutants or TCF-dependent transcription.

name: TNFR1 and linear ubiquitin-driven canonical NF-kappaB activation
rationale: Members cover TNFR1 signalling, linear polyubiquitination and NF-kappaB transcription factor activity, distinguished from confusables on TLR/RIP1 IKK recruitment, negative regulation or non-canonical NF-kappaB.

name: Cellular energy substrate transport and phosphocreatine buffering
rationale: Members cover transport of lactate, pyruvate, glucose, carnitine and ATP with creatine/phosphocreatine metabolism, unlike confusables on di/tricarboxylate shuttles, organic anions or fatty acid transport.
